scope: Local Qtoken_FS and SF-v2-S6-D3-H9-C-FS/gru8 records only

front_segmenter.limitation: Video file indices are not canonical episode IDs; complete mappings and checkpoint identity are not verified.

side_segmenter.limitation: Video file indices are not canonical episode IDs; complete mappings and checkpoint identity are not verified.

base_policy.limitation: The entry point loads the supplied dataset root. Any upstream episode filtering remains unverified.

residual_head.code_claim: Residual-head-held-out episodes only; frozen base may have seen all episodes
residual_head.limitation: Do not reconstruct historical episode IDs from the seed without the original records and cache split.

required_evidence: Full prompt and segmenter training/validation manifests
Mapping from segmentation video files and dataset versions to original collection episode IDs
Base-policy input dataset episode manifest and any upstream filtering record
Original residual-cache split.json and matching manifest.json
Frozen checkpoint hashes and their matching preprocessing/class definitions

prospective_protocol.rule: Create the canonical split before fitting any stage; preserve episode identity through all derived datasets.
prospective_protocol.calibration: Fit quality thresholds and temperature only on designated development/calibration episodes.
prospective_protocol.testing: Keep final audit and test episodes out of all fitting and model-selection stages.
